# Configuration reference: glasses platform settings

**Status: pre-alpha.** The plugin validates these settings (when the gateway loads it, and with `python -m glasses.admin config check`) but does not serve the glasses yet. A key marked **Planned** is accepted and validated and has no effect yet.

Settings of the glasses platform plugin under gateway.platforms.glasses.extra in the Hermes config. glasses/config.py validates with this schema (types, ranges, patterns) plus the rules a schema cannot express (public\_url normal form, absolute paths, the 107-byte socket limit, home\_lane in lanes). Keys the Hermes gateway itself injects are not ours and are skipped; access-control keys Hermes would act on are refused; any other unknown key is a warning. An unknown key that is a near-miss of a key at the same level (at most max(2, 20 % of that key's length) edits after lower-casing and reading '-' as '\_') gets a 'did you mean \<key\>?' hint, and its name is shown only then and only when it looks like a key name (1-32 characters, an ASCII letter first, then letters, '\_' and '-', at most 2 digits); any other name is shown as \<an unknown key of N characters\> (it could be a pasted secret or forge an output line). x-error / x-errors / x-hint are the user-facing messages ('glasses.\<path\>: \<x-error\> (got \<value\>) — \<x-hint\>'); a string value is shown only when x-echo is true and it contains neither '@' nor '://' (it could carry credentials); URL- and credential-capable keys (public\_url, meeting.endpoint, meeting.provider, meeting.llm.\*) are never echoed. x-status: planned marks a key whose feature is not built yet: it is accepted and validated but has no effect.

Source: `hermes-plugin/glasses/config.schema.json`. Regenerate this file with `python3 tools/codegen/gen_config_docs.py`.

## Example

Every key with its default, URLs and host names as `example.com` placeholders:

```yaml
gateway:
  platforms:
    glasses:
      extra:
        edge:
          socket: ""
          user: ""
        bridge_port: 8766
        state_dir: null
        public_url: "wss://glasses.example.com/ws"
        lanes: ["assistant"]
        home_lane: "assistant"
        client_cert_header: "X-Client-Cert"
        client_cert_encoding: "pem-urlescaped"
        long_threshold: 280
        long_answers:
          platform: "telegram"
        signer:
          socket: ""
          user: ""
          public_dir: ""
        meeting:
          enabled: false
          provider: "soniox"
          endpoint: "stt.example.com"
          language_hints: []
          transcript_days: 30
          max_minutes: 180
          daily_hours: 0
          live_notes: false
          llm:
            provider: ""
            model: ""
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Range | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `edge` | mapping or null | `{"socket": "", "user": ""}` | — | — | The hop from the TLS edge to the plugin: the plugin serves /ws and /enroll only on a unix socket, never on TCP. The edge proxy connects to edge.socket; only a peer running as the system user edge.user is admitted. |
| `edge.socket` | string or null | `""` | length ≤ 107 | `""` | Absolute path of the plugin's unix socket, at most 107 bytes UTF-8 (the AF\_UNIX limit, not characters), without a .. component; empty = unset (the listener then refuses to start; there is no TCP fallback). |
| `edge.user` | string or null | `""` | pattern `^([a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31})?$` | `""` | System user the TLS edge runs as: the only peer uid the plugin admits on the socket; not root; empty = unset. |
| `bridge_port` | integer | `8766` | 1–65535 | `8766` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. Loopback port of the phone bridge (MCP server), bound on 127.0.0.1. |
| `state_dir` | string or null | `null` | length ≤ 4096 | `null` | Absolute directory for the plugin state; empty or null = $HERMES\_HOME/glasses. Used today by glasses-admin crl --check (its rollback record crl-seen.json, the highest CRL number seen per CA), config check --live and glasses-admin revoke (it connects to the plugin's admin socket admin.sock here; the server is planned); the plugin keeps no CA key and no CRL here; the plugin's outbox is outbox.sqlite here (mode 0600): it holds the text of each answer until the phone acks it; there is no timer: rows older than 24 h are deleted at the next answer, reconnect or plugin start, a revoked device's rows (purged) at the next answer, its next refused connect or plugin start, and over 500 rows per device the oldest are evicted; the device registry (planned) will live here too. The directory must be owned by the plugin user with mode 0700, the only supported mode: last-seen, the deny overlay and crl --check refuse anything else; the outbox alone tolerates a readable 0755 one but refuses a group- or world-writable one, and then the start fails (retryable). |
| `public_url` | string | `""` | length ≤ 2048 | `"wss://glasses.example.com/ws"` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. Public wss:// URL the app connects to (carried in the enrolment QR); stored normalised. |
| `lanes` | list of string | `["assistant"]` | items ≤ 32; unique; each: length ≤ 32; pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$`; no line breaks | `["assistant"]` | Global lane allowlist: the lane of an inbound message (msg.in) must be in it and in the device's registry lanes, else the device gets error lane\_forbidden; \[\] = the device's lanes only. At most 32 (= protocol welcome.lanes maxItems). |
| `home_lane` | string | `"assistant"` | length ≤ 40; pattern `^(?:(?:glasses:)?[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31})?$`; no line breaks | `"assistant"` | Lane of an inbound message (msg.in) that names no lane; also the lane of the home channel (glasses:\<lane\>, planned). Empty = such a message is refused (lane\_forbidden). Must be one of lanes when lanes is not empty. |
| `client_cert_header` | string | `"X-Client-Cert"` | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$`; no line breaks | `"X-Client-Cert"` | HTTP header the TLS edge forwards the client certificate in; the plugin verifies that certificate against the signer's device-ca.pem and never reads a forwarded fingerprint. |
| `client_cert_encoding` | string | `"pem-urlescaped"` | one of `"pem-urlescaped"`, `"der-base64"` | `"pem-urlescaped"` | pem-urlescaped (nginx $ssl\_client\_escaped\_cert) or der-base64 (Caddy). |
| `long_threshold` | integer | `280` | 1–512 | `280` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. Characters (1-512 = msg.out.text 2048 B // 4) above which an answer goes to the long-answer platform; UTF-8 bytes \> 2048 also count as long. |
| `long_answers` | mapping or null | `{"platform": "telegram"}` | — | — | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. Where long answers go. |
| `long_answers.platform` | string | `"telegram"` | length ≤ 32; pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$`; not `"glasses"` | `"telegram"` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. Hermes platform that receives long answers (never glasses itself). |
| `signer` | mapping or null | `{"socket": "", "user": "", "public_dir": ""}` | — | — | The device-CA signer: a separate local service (planned, built outside this repository) that the plugin asks to issue and revoke device certificates. Used today: socket and user by glasses-admin crl and glasses-admin revoke, public\_dir by glasses-admin crl --check. |
| `signer.socket` | string or null | `""` | length ≤ 107 | `""` | Absolute path of the signer's unix socket, at most 107 bytes UTF-8 (the AF\_UNIX limit, not characters); the plugin refuses it unless it is a socket owned by signer.user; empty = unset. |
| `signer.user` | string or null | `""` | pattern `^([a-z_][a-z0-9_-]{0,31})?$`; no line breaks | `""` | System user the signer runs as: the owner of its socket and the peer uid the plugin requires; not root and not the plugin's own user; empty = unset. |
| `signer.public_dir` | string or null | `""` | length ≤ 4096 | `""` | Absolute directory where the signer publishes device-ca.pem, devices-crl.pem and devices.json; glasses-admin crl --check reads the first two; empty = unset. Set up so that the directory and every parent are owned by root or the signer user and not writable by the plugin user, and devices.json is owned by the signer user with mode 0640 or stricter. The plugin itself refuses a directory that is a symlink, owned by the plugin user or writable by group or others, and a devices.json that is missing, a symlink, owned by anyone but the signer user, wider than 0640, oversize or corrupt (it does not check the parents). In each of those cases no new device connection is accepted; cutting sessions that are already live is the watcher of T1.63a (not built yet). |
| `meeting` | mapping or null | `{}` | — | — | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. Settings of meeting mode. Off unless enabled here and per device. |
| `meeting.enabled` | boolean | `false` | — | `false` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. |
| `meeting.provider` | string | `"soniox"` | one of `"soniox"`, `"deepgram"`, `"speechmatics"` | `"soniox"` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. the key stays on the server: the plugin reads it from the provider's environment variable in the gateway environment (supply it from a secret manager); the phone only gets short-lived tokens |
| `meeting.endpoint` | string | `""` | length ≤ 253; pattern `^(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(?:\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*)?$`; no line breaks | `"stt.example.com"` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. Provider host (region); empty = the provider default. |
| `meeting.language_hints` | list of string | `[]` | items ≤ 8; unique; each: length ≤ 35; pattern `^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})*$`; no line breaks | `[]` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. 0-8 BCP 47 tags; \[\] = auto-detect (generic default). |
| `meeting.transcript_days` | integer | `30` | 0–3650 | `30` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. days transcripts are kept |
| `meeting.max_minutes` | integer | `180` | 1–1440 | `180` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. longest single meeting in minutes |
| `meeting.daily_hours` | integer | `0` | 0–24 | `0` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. daily cap of meeting hours; 0 = no daily cap |
| `meeting.live_notes` | boolean | `false` | — | `false` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. |
| `meeting.llm` | mapping or null | `{}` | — | — | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. Optional provider/model passed to the plugin LLM API; empty = the deployer's active model. |
| `meeting.llm.provider` | string | `""` | length ≤ 64; pattern `^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63})?$`; no line breaks | `""` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. |
| `meeting.llm.model` | string | `""` | length ≤ 128; pattern `^[!-~]*$`; no line breaks | `""` | **Planned** — accepted and validated, no effect yet. |
